summary: Iter 309 — Access Pay migrated from standalone input into the certification matrix. Backend & frontend fully verified. 4/4 pytest tests pass and UI shows Access Pay as a product with P/C/N-A toggle; edit form no longer has 'integrator-accespay-input' while V3 fields (comercios, componente_version) remain.

issues: React hydration warnings — <span data-ve-dynamic="true"> is being rendered as a direct child of <tbody> and around <tr> elements (Integrators.jsx around line 1928 and Dashboard.jsx around line 374). Not blocking, but pollutes the console and can cause hydration mismatches.
Duplicate React key detected in a Select ('Arnoldo Hernandez'), suggests two active users with identical display names in the coordinator or gestor dropdown — should use user_id as key.

action_items: (Low) Replace name-based keys in Integrator edit dialog user Selects with user_id to avoid duplicate-key warning.
(Low) Fix ve-dynamic <span> wrappers being emitted inside <tbody>/around <tr> — either use React.Fragment or move the wrapper outside the table to remove hydration warnings.
(Low) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Editar Proyecto de Integración modal.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/integrators.py is very large (~2872 lines) — consider splitting import/template/export logic into a dedicated module.
In list_integrator_products, response uses key 'service_id' for a 'prod_*' id — legacy naming; documented as intentional (drop-in for /services) — OK but worth a code comment.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 QAAP_UI_AccessPay integrator via UI script and 1 QAAP_AccessPayCert via import; both deleted at end of run. No leftover QAAP_ data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter309_access_pay_as_product.py covers products endpoint, import template column positions (AI..AN), import upsert with 'Access Pay'->certifications.prod_access_pay, and confirms 'accespay_product' is not persisted. All pass. Frontend: cert-<intg>-prod_access_pay button appears inside cert-matrix-<intg>; integrator-accespay-input has been removed; V3 fields intact.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature verification, no bug found.
